title: DC Comics Presents Superman Secret Identity #1 100-Page 2011 Busiek Immonen
conditionDescription: Cover has light soiling and a small stain near the title, scuffing along the left edge and spine wear; back cover edge wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
DC Comics Presents: Superman - Secret Identity #1 (December 2011), DC Comics - 100-Page Spectacular reprinting Kurt Busiek and Stuart Immonen's acclaimed Superman: Secret Identity. Square-bound, $7.99 cover price.

Back cover: Deus Ex: Human Revolution (Square Enix) ad.

Condition: light soiling and a small stain on the cover near the title, scuffing along the left edge and spine wear; edge wear on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
